e.title: **精算包的「接线层」本身**：JuliaActuary 的 **FinanceCore.jl**——**它明说「你不该直接用我」**，**并列出「谁再导出我、再导出什么」**；**实测只有两个依赖**、**用 Julia 的 `ext/` 扩展机制把 LoopVectorization 接成可选加速**、**CI 里另有一条 `downgrade` 任务专门把 `[compat]` 里声明的最低版本真的装起来跑一遍**
e.title_en: The wiring layer of an actuarial package family: FinanceCore.jl from JuliaActuary, which states plainly that users should generally not use it directly, lists exactly which packages re-export which of its types and functions, carries only two hard dependencies, wires LoopVectorization in as optional acceleration through the Julia package extension mechanism, and runs a dedicated downgrade CI job that actually installs and tests the lower version bounds declared in its compat section.
e.title_hk: **精算包的「接線層」本身**：JuliaActuary 的 **FinanceCore.jl**——**它明說「你不該直接用我」**，**並列出「誰再導出我、再導出什麼」**；**實測只有兩個依賴**、**用 Julia 的 `ext/` 擴展機制把 LoopVectorization 接成可選加速**、**CI 裡另有一條 `downgrade` 任務專門把 `[compat]` 裡聲明的最低版本真的裝起來跑一遍**
e.summary: **FinanceCore.jl**（仓库 `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`）**是 JuliaActuary 精算包家族的最底层包**，**版本 2.7.0**、**许可 MIT**、**实测 ★3**、**998 KB**、**创建 2022-06-14**、**推送 2026-09-08**。**它在本轮主题里的价值是「接线」的**另一种样子**：**它自己不面向终端用户，而是被别人再导出**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它逐字写出**「**Users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data/methods as necessary.**」**，**并只留两个例外**（**逐字**「**If you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import/use this package directly.**」）**——**⭐ 即**它把「什么时候该直接依赖我」写成一条判据**；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **它把「谁拿走了什么」分成三节列清**（**Reexported by ActuaryUtilities.jl**：`irr`、`internal_rate_of_return`；**Reexported by FinanceModels.jl**：`Rate`／`Frequency`、`discount`／`accumulation`／`forward`；**Used by multiple packages**：`Cashflow`／`Quote`、`amount`／`timepoint`、`present_value`／`pv`）**——**⭐ 即**一个底层包的 README 最该回答的是「**别人从我这里拿走了什么**」，**而不是「我有什么」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **它用 Julia 的扩展机制接可选依赖**：`[weakdeps] LoopVectorization`、`[extensions] FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt = "LoopVectorization"`、`ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl` **实测存在**，**并通过包内私有函数** `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend(...)` **挂上去**——**⭐ 并逐字写明两条数值限制**（「**Reassociation and LoopVectorization’s exp may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp.**」／「**The public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64, so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD.**」）；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **CI 里有一条任务专门跑 `[compat]` 的最低版本**（`downgrade` job，**逐字注释**「**Tests the lower bounds declared in [compat] by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building.**」）**——**声明的兼容范围不是口号，**而是被一条会失败的测试接住了**；**⭐⭐ ⑤** **格式检查与 `git blame` 是一对**（CI 有 `runic` job，仓库根 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 里逐字是注释 `# Adding Runic formatting` 加三个 40 位提交号）。**⚠️ 本次未安装 Julia、未运行或测试该包、未读 `src/` 任何文件**，故**不主张**任何函数或类型的签名与数值行为；**⚠️ `[deps]` 实测只有 `Dates` 与 `Roots` 两个**。
e.summary_hk: **FinanceCore.jl**（倉庫 `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`）**是 JuliaActuary 精算包家族的最底層包**，**版本 2.7.0**、**許可 MIT**、**實測 ★3**、**998 KB**、**建立 2022-06-14**、**推送 2026-09-08**。**它在本輪主題裡的價值是「接線」的**另一種樣子**：**它自己不面向終端使用者，而是被別人再導出**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它逐字寫出**「**Users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data/methods as necessary.**」**，**並只留兩個例外**（**逐字**「**If you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import/use this package directly.**」）**——**⭐ 即**它把「什麼時候該直接依賴我」寫成一條判據**；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **它把「誰拿走了什麼」分成三節列清**（**Reexported by ActuaryUtilities.jl**：`irr`、`internal_rate_of_return`；**Reexported by FinanceModels.jl**：`Rate`／`Frequency`、`discount`／`accumulation`／`forward`；**Used by multiple packages**：`Cashflow`／`Quote`、`amount`／`timepoint`、`present_value`／`pv`）**——**⭐ 即**一個底層包的 README 最該回答的是「**別人從我這裡拿走了什麼**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **它用 Julia 的擴展機制接可選依賴**：`[weakdeps] LoopVectorization`、`[extensions] FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt = "LoopVectorization"`、`ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl` **實測存在**，**並透過包內私有函數** `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend(...)` **掛上去**——**⭐ 並逐字寫明兩條數值限制**（「**Reassociation and LoopVectorization’s exp may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp.**」／「**The public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64, so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD.**」）；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **CI 裡有一條任務專門跑 `[compat]` 的最低版本**（`downgrade` job，**逐字註解**「**Tests the lower bounds declared in [compat] by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building.**」）**——**聲明的相容範圍不是口號，**而是被一條會失敗的測試接住了**；**⭐⭐ ⑤** **格式檢查與 `git blame` 是一對**（CI 有 `runic` job，倉庫根 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 逐字是註解 `# Adding Runic formatting` 加三個 40 位提交號）。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 Julia、未運行或測試該包、未讀 `src/` 任何檔案**，故**不主張**任何函數或型別的簽名與數值行為；**⚠️ `[deps]` 實測只有 `Dates` 與 `Roots` 兩個**。
e.summary_en: **FinanceCore.jl** (repository `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`) **is the lowest layer of the JuliaActuary actuarial package family**, at **version 2.7.0**, **licence MIT**, **measured 3 stars**, **998 KB**, **created 2022-06-14**, **pushed 2026-09-08**. **Its value for this round is a different shape of wiring: it does not face end users at all, it is re-exported by others.** **First, top** it says verbatim that users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data and methods as necessary, **and leaves exactly two exceptions**, verbatim: if you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import or use this package directly, **so it states when you should depend on it directly as a criterion rather than a preference**. **Second, top** **it lists who took what, in three sections**: `irr` and `internal_rate_of_return` re-exported by ActuaryUtilities.jl; `Rate` and `Frequency`, plus `discount`, `accumulation` and `forward`, re-exported by FinanceModels.jl; and `Cashflow` and `Quote`, the `amount` and `timepoint` accessors, and `present_value` and `pv` used by multiple packages, **which means the README of a low-level package answers who takes what from it rather than what it contains**. **Third, top** **it wires an optional dependency through the Julia package extension mechanism**: `[weakdeps] LoopVectorization`, an `[extensions]` entry naming `FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt`, and a measurably present `ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl`, **hooked in through a package-private function** named `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend`, with two numerical limits stated verbatim: that reassociation and the LoopVectorization exponential may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp, and that the public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64 so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD. **Fourth, top** **a CI job exists purely to run the lowest versions declared in the compat section**, the `downgrade` job, with the verbatim comment that it tests the lower bounds declared in the compat section by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building, **so a declared compatibility range is not a claim but something a failing test is wired to**. **Fifth** **formatting and blame form a pair**: CI runs a `runic` job and the repository root carries a blame-ignore file whose contents are, verbatim, the comment about adding Runic formatting followed by three full forty-character commit hashes. **Julia was not installed this round, the package was neither run nor tested, and no file under `src/` was read**, so this entry makes no claim about the signature or numerical behaviour of any function or type; **the measured hard dependencies are exactly two, `Dates` and `Roots`**.
e.body:
**FinanceCore.jl**（仓库 `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`）**是 JuliaActuary 精算包家族的最底层包**，**版本 2.7.0**（`Project.toml` 实测 `version = "2.7.0"`，**注册身份** `uuid = "b9b1ffdd-6612-4b69-8227-7663be06e089"`）、**语言 Julia**、**许可 MIT**、**实测 ★3**、**仓库体量 998 KB**、**创建 2022-06-14**、**最后推送 2026-09-08**、**默认分支 `main`**；**README 实测 1,457 字节**。**文件清单本次经 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball 枚举**（**本轮 GitHub 核心 API 配额已用尽**），**实测 30 条路径，其中 7 个目录、23 个文件**：`src/` 下 `FinanceCore.jl`、`Contracts.jl`、`irr.jl`、`pv.jl`、`Rates.jl`；`test/` 下 `runtests.jl`、`contracts.jl`、`irr.jl`、`present_value.jl`、`Rates.jl` 与 `Project.toml`；`docs/` 下 `make.jl`、`Project.toml`、`src/index.md`；`ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl`；`.github/workflows/` 下 `CI.yml`、`CompatHelper.yml`、`TagBot.yml`；**另有** `Project.toml`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`.gitignore`、`.git-blame-ignore-revs`。本条目属于本轮主题**「接线：把它接到另一套东西上能用为止」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里唯一一条**把「接线」讲在**依赖关系层面**的**：**它自己就是那条被接的线**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`Project.toml`、`ext/` 文件、`CI.yml`、`.git-blame-ignore-revs` 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它明说「你不该直接用我」，并只留两个例外**——**正文逐字**：**「**This repository contains foundational types and routines that are used in other packages.**」**，**紧接**「**Users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data/methods as necessary.**」**，**再给出例外**：**「**If you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import/use this package directly.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮值得抄的一处**：**一个底层包最好的文档不是「我能做什么」，而是**「你应该用哪一层、以及什么情况下才该下到我这一层」**——**它把读者往上游推，而不是把使用者留在自己这里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把「谁拿走了什么」分成三节列清**——**逐字三个小节标题与条目**：**「**Reexported by ActuaryUtilities.jl**」**：`irr` 与 `internal_rate_of_return`；**「**Reexported by FinanceModels.jl**」**：`Rate`s 与 `Frequency`s，以及 `discount`、`accumulation`、`forward` 三个函数；**「**Used by multiple packages**」**：`Cashflow` 与 `Quote` 两个类型、`amount` 与 `timepoint` 两个访问器、`present_value` 与 `pv` 两个函数。**⭐ 即**这份清单回答的是**别人从我这里拿走了什么、又从哪条路径拿**——**这正是「接线图」在包管理层面的样子**：**它不描述自己，它描述自己与上层的关系**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它用 Julia 的扩展机制把可选依赖接成加速后端**——`Project.toml` 实测：`[weakdeps]` 下 `LoopVectorization = "bdcacae8-1622-11e9-2a5c-532679323890"`，`[extensions]` 下 `FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt = "LoopVectorization"`，**对应文件** `ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl` **实测存在**。**⭐ 四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 扩展是用一条「私有函数」挂上去的**——**文件里逐字为** `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend(r::T, cashflows::StridedVector{T}, times::TurboTimes{T})`，**即**函数名带**前导下划线**（**Julia 社区用下划线表示内部实现**），**并重定义了** `FinanceCore.__pv_div_pv′`（**名字末尾是一个 U+2032 PRIME 字符，不是撇号**）；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**这是一种**约定式接线**：**扩展点没有写进公开 API，而是靠包内私有名字**——**本词条不评价其优劣**，**但把它记下来**，**因为下划线名字在语义上并没有稳定性承诺**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把两个后端的数值差异量化了**——**文件内注释逐字**：**「**Reassociation and LoopVectorization’s exp may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp.**」**——**即**「**快的那条路算出来的结果与慢的那条不完全相同，差多少也写明了**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这比「我们会自动加速」有用得多**：**加速是有代价的，代价写在旁边**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 同一文件还写明一条能力边界**——**逐字**：**「**The public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64, so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD. Float32 remains valid for direct and future type-preserving solver calls.**」**——**即**它承认 **Float32 路径目前回落到 SIMD**，**同时又说明 Float32 在直接调用与未来类型保持的求解器调用里仍然有效**：**一处限制 + 一处仍然成立的范围**。**④ ⭐⭐ 它还留了一条「为什么这么写」的注释**——**逐字**：**「**The public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64**」**里的 **currently** 一词**即**「这是当下的实现状态，不是设计约束」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ CI 里有一条任务专门跑 `[compat]` 里声明的最低版本**——`CI.yml`（**实测 3,616 字节级别以外的另一份文件，本次从 tarball 直读**）的 `downgrade` job 用 `julia-actions/julia-downgrade-compat@v1`、**参数** `skip: Dates` 与 `strict: ‘true’`，**并逐字注释两处理由**：**「**Tests the lower bounds declared in [compat] by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building.**」**与**「**exact "=floor" pins for every entry, incl. >=1.0 (default v0 tilde-pins those)**」。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最硬的一处**：**`[compat]` 里写的 `Roots = "1.0.12, 2"`、`LoopVectorization = "0.12.166"`、`julia = "1.10"` 通常只是声明**，**而这个仓库把「下界仍然可用」接到了一条会失败的测试上**——**声明的兼容范围因此变成可核查的东西**（**本次逐字引用该注释时把原文的 ASCII 直引号写作弓形引号以维持本词条的引号约定，注释内容未改**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 格式检查与 `git blame` 是一对**：CI 有 `runic` job（`uses: fredrikekre/runic-action@v1`，`with: version: ‘1’`），**而仓库根有** `.git-blame-ignore-revs`，**内容逐字是一行注释加三个提交号**——**注释为** `# Adding Runic formatting`，**三个提交号为** `288af3220d7e8e4506eda62d26091c97dec58102`、`0ce7dc006ac89a7184da17267fc17d530e5e3c7a`、`def34a8b2dcc09ffcd17ebcdd5a65c43bd034e2f`。**⭐ 即**「**格式检查**」与「**让 `git blame` 跳过格式化提交**」**是同一件事的两半**：**加一个格式化工具会污染历史，它把这份污染从 blame 里接出去**；**本词条现场核对了这三个号都是完整的 40 位十六进制**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依赖面压到最小**：`[deps]` **实测只有两个**（`Dates` 与 `Roots`），`[compat]` 另写明 `Dates = "1"`、`Roots = "1.0.12, 2"`、`LoopVectorization = "0.12.166"`、`julia = "1.10"`。**⭐ 即**一个「被很多包依赖的底层包」把**硬依赖**压到两个，**把**加速**放到弱依赖里**——**接线层越薄，能接上来的人越多**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 测试矩阵跨三个系统、四个版本标签**：`test` job 的 matrix 为 ubuntu／`min`、ubuntu／`1`、macOS／`1`、windows／`1`、ubuntu／`pre`，**其中 `pre` 一格 `continue-on-error: true`**（**允许预览版失败而不把主状态拉红**），**并设** `fail-fast: false`；**覆盖率经** `julia-actions/julia-processcoverage@v1` **生成** `lcov.info` **后交** `codecov/codecov-action@v5`（**带** `token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}`）。**⭐ 即**「**最低版本**（min）」与「**预览版**（pre）」**各占一格，且失败后果不同**——**一个必须过，一个允许不过**。**⭐ ⑧ 它还接了 Julia 生态的两条自动化**：`.github/workflows/` **实测三条**——`CI.yml`、**`CompatHelper.yml`**（**依赖上界需要更新时自动开 PR**）、**`TagBot.yml`**（**注册后自动打 tag**）。**⭐ ⑨ 徽章五个，都指向可核查对象**：docs-stable 与 docs-dev（`JuliaActuary.github.io/FinanceCore.jl/stable`／`/dev`）、**CI**（**指向 `CI.yml` 且限定** `branch=main`）、**Codecov**、**Aqua QA**（**指向** `JuliaTesting/Aqua.jl`）。**⚠️ Aqua 是 Julia 生态里做包质量一致性自动检查的工具，但本次未核实它的检查项清单**，**故本词条不展开它具体检查什么**。**⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的接线**：**本条补上的是** [[actuaryutilities-jl]] 与 [[financemodels-jl]] **共同依赖的那一层**，**也把** [[experienceanalysis-jl]]、[[mortalitytables-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]、[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[hmd-jl]]、[[copulas-jl]]、[[conformalprediction-jl]] **这一组条目的家族关系补上一条依赖边**；**与** [[quantlib]]、[[financepy]]、[[yieldcurves]] **这类「自带完整实现」的库对照，本条记录的是另一种设计取向：把公共类型抽到最底层、让上层再导出**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[actuaryutilities-jl]]、[[financemodels-jl]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「一个精算开源家族如何分层」的最小样本**：**最底层只放类型与公共运算、上层再导出、用弱依赖挂加速、用 CI 把声明的最低版本真的跑一遍**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 Julia、没有运行或测试该包**（**未 `Pkg.instantiate`、未跑 `runtests.jl`、未调用任何函数**），**故不主张任何函数或类型按所述工作，也不主张任何性能或数值结论**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 `src/` 下任何文件**——**本次只读了** `README.md`、`Project.toml`、`ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl`、`.github/workflows/CI.yml`、`.git-blame-ignore-revs` **五个文件与一份完整文件清单**，**故不主张** `irr`、`pv`、`Rate`、`Cashflow` 等 API 的签名、返回类型、数值行为、精度或收敛性质。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 Aqua 的检查项清单、Codecov 当前覆盖率数字、CompatHelper 与 TagBot 是否仍在运行**（**本次只读到这三个工作流文件存在**）；**未核实** `docs/src/index.md` 的内容与文档站是否可打开。**④ ⚠️ 本词条指出的风险点不是结论**：**扩展通过前导下划线的私有函数挂载**，**本次未核实该函数名在后续版本是否保持**——**本词条只记录这一事实，不对其稳定性作判断**。**⑤ ⚠️ 文件清单本次经 tarball 枚举而非 GitHub tree 接口**（**本轮核心 API 配额用尽**），**故「23 个文件／7 个目录」是本次 tarball 口径的统计**；**未核实 README 之外是否有未纳入本次阅读范围的文档**。**⑥ ⚠️ ★3，未核实 fork 数、下载量、注册表版本是否为最新**（**本次未查 Julia 注册表**）；**未核实** 作者背景与维护活跃度。**⑦ ⚠️ 创建 2022-06-14 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按「窗口例外需点名缺口」的惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「被上层再导出的底层包」这一层此前在池内没有单独条目**（**池内 [[actuaryutilities-jl]] 与 [[financemodels-jl]] 都在，但没有一条记录它们共同依赖的那一层**）。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**，**版本号 2.7.0 为该日 `Project.toml` 的值**。 **⑨ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用该注释时，把 `LoopVectorization’s exp` 里原文的 ASCII 撇号写作 ’，以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（注释内容未改）**。

**FinanceCore.jl**（倉庫 `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`）**是 JuliaActuary 精算包家族的最底層包**，**版本 2.7.0**（`Project.toml` 實測 `version = "2.7.0"`，**註冊身份** `uuid = "b9b1ffdd-6612-4b69-8227-7663be06e089"`）、**語言 Julia**、**許可 MIT**、**實測 ★3**、**倉庫體量 998 KB**、**建立 2022-06-14**、**最後推送 2026-09-08**、**預設分支 `main`**；**README 實測 1,457 位元組**。**檔案清單本次經 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball 列舉**（**本輪 GitHub 核心 API 配額已用盡**），**實測 30 條路徑，其中 7 個目錄、23 個檔案**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「接線：把它接到另一套東西上能用為止」**；**本詞條認為它是本輪四條裡唯一一條**把「接線」講在**依賴關係層面**的**：**它自己就是那條被接的線**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`Project.toml`、`ext/` 檔案、`CI.yml`、`.git-blame-ignore-revs` 與檔案清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它明說「你不該直接用我」，並只留兩個例外**——**正文逐字**：**「**This repository contains foundational types and routines that are used in other packages.**」**，**緊接**「**Users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data/methods as necessary.**」**，**再給出例外**：**「**If you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import/use this package directly.**」**。**⭐ 即**一個底層包最好的文件不是「我能做什麼」，**而是**「你應該用哪一層、以及什麼情況下才該下到我這一層」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把「誰拿走了什麼」分成三節列清**——**逐字三個小節標題**：**「**Reexported by ActuaryUtilities.jl**」**（`irr`、`internal_rate_of_return`）；**「**Reexported by FinanceModels.jl**」**（`Rate`s 與 `Frequency`s，以及 `discount`、`accumulation`、`forward`）；**「**Used by multiple packages**」**（`Cashflow` 與 `Quote`、`amount` 與 `timepoint`、`present_value` 與 `pv`）。**⭐ 即**這份清單回答的是**別人從我這裡拿走了什麼、又從哪條路徑拿**——**這正是「接線圖」在套件管理層面的樣子**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它用 Julia 的擴展機制把可選依賴接成加速後端**——`Project.toml` 實測：`[weakdeps]` 下 `LoopVectorization`，`[extensions]` 下 `FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt = "LoopVectorization"`，**對應檔案** `ext/FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt.jl` **實測存在**。**⭐ 四處值得記**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 擴展是用一條「私有函數」掛上去的**——**逐字為** `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend(...)`，**函數名帶前導下劃線**，**並重定義了** `FinanceCore.__pv_div_pv′`（**末尾是一個 U+2032 PRIME 字元，不是撇號**）——**本詞條如實指出**這是一種**約定式接線**：**擴展點沒有寫進公開 API，而是靠包內私有名字**，**不評價其優劣，但記下來**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把兩個後端的數值差異量化了**——**逐字**：**「**Reassociation and LoopVectorization’s exp may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp.**」**——**即**「**快的那條路算出來的結果與慢的那條不完全相同，差多少也寫明了**」。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 同一檔案還寫明一條能力邊界**——**逐字**：**「**The public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64, so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD. Float32 remains valid for direct and future type-preserving solver calls.**」**——**一處限制 ＋ 一處仍然成立的範圍**。**④ ⭐⭐ 它留了一條「為什麼這麼寫」的註解**（**`currently` 一詞即**「這是當下的實作狀態，不是設計約束」）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ CI 裡有一條任務專門跑 `[compat]` 裡聲明的最低版本**——`downgrade` job 用 `julia-actions/julia-downgrade-compat@v1`、**參數** `skip: Dates` 與 `strict: ‘true’`，**並逐字註解兩處理由**：**「**Tests the lower bounds declared in [compat] by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building.**」**與**「**exact "=floor" pins for every entry, incl. >=1.0 (default v0 tilde-pins those)**」。**⭐ 即**`[compat]` 裡寫的下界**通常只是聲明**，**而這個倉庫把「下界仍然可用」接到了一條會失敗的測試上**（**本次逐字引用該註解時把原文的 ASCII 直引號寫作弓形引號以維持本詞條的引號約定，註解內容未改**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 格式檢查與 `git blame` 是一對**：CI 有 `runic` job（`fredrikekre/runic-action@v1`），**而倉庫根有** `.git-blame-ignore-revs`，**內容逐字是一行註解加三個提交號**——**註解為** `# Adding Runic formatting`，**三個提交號為** `288af3220d7e8e4506eda62d26091c97dec58102`、`0ce7dc006ac89a7184da17267fc17d530e5e3c7a`、`def34a8b2dcc09ffcd17ebcdd5a65c43bd034e2f`。**⭐ 即**「**格式檢查**」與「**讓 `git blame` 跳過格式化提交**」**是同一件事的兩半**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依賴面壓到最小**：`[deps]` **實測只有兩個**（`Dates` 與 `Roots`），`[compat]` 另寫明 `Dates = "1"`、`Roots = "1.0.12, 2"`、`LoopVectorization = "0.12.166"`、`julia = "1.10"`——**硬依賴兩個，加速放進弱依賴**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 測試矩陣跨三個系統、四個版本標籤**：matrix 為 ubuntu／`min`、ubuntu／`1`、macOS／`1`、windows／`1`、ubuntu／`pre`，**其中 `pre` 一格 `continue-on-error: true`**，**並設** `fail-fast: false`；**覆蓋率經** `julia-processcoverage` **交** Codecov（**帶** `secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN`）。**⭐ ⑧ 它還接了 Julia 生態的兩條自動化**：`.github/workflows/` **實測三條**——`CI.yml`、**`CompatHelper.yml`**（**依賴上界需更新時自動開 PR**）、**`TagBot.yml`**（**註冊後自動打 tag**）。**⭐ ⑨ 徽章五個**：docs-stable、docs-dev、**CI**（**限定** `branch=main`）、**Codecov**、**Aqua QA**（**指向** `JuliaTesting/Aqua.jl`）。**⚠️ Aqua 是 Julia 生態裡做套件品質一致性自動檢查的工具，但本次未核實它的檢查項清單**，**故不展開**。**⭐ ⑩ 與池內條目的接線**：**本條補上的是** [[actuaryutilities-jl]] 與 [[financemodels-jl]] **共同依賴的那一層**，**也把** [[experienceanalysis-jl]]、[[mortalitytables-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]、[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[hmd-jl]]、[[copulas-jl]]、[[conformalprediction-jl]] **這一組條目的家族關係補上一條依賴邊**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[actuaryutilities-jl]]、[[financemodels-jl]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「一個精算開源家族如何分層」的最小樣本**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 Julia、沒有運行或測試該包**，**故不主張任何函數或型別按所述工作，也不主張任何效能或數值結論**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 `src/` 下任何檔案**——**本次只讀了五個檔案與一份完整檔案清單**，**故不主張** `irr`、`pv`、`Rate`、`Cashflow` 等 API 的簽名、返回型別、數值行為、精度或收斂性質。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實 Aqua 的檢查項、Codecov 當前覆蓋率數字、CompatHelper 與 TagBot 是否仍在運行**；**未核實**文件站是否可打開。**④ ⚠️ 本詞條指出的風險點不是結論**：**擴展透過前導下劃線的私有函數掛載**，**本次未核實該函數名在後續版本是否保持**。**⑤ ⚠️ 檔案清單本次經 tarball 列舉而非 GitHub tree 介面**（**本輪核心 API 配額用盡**）。**⑥ ⚠️ ★3，未核實 fork 數、下載量、註冊表版本是否為最新**。**⑦ ⚠️ 建立 2022-06-14 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「被上層再導出的底層包」這一層此前在池內沒有單獨條目**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**，**版本號 2.7.0 為該日 `Project.toml` 的值**。 **⑨ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用該註解時，把 `LoopVectorization’s exp` 裡原文的 ASCII 摹號寫作 ’，以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（註解內容未改）**。

**FinanceCore.jl** (repository `JuliaActuary/FinanceCore.jl`) **is the lowest layer of the JuliaActuary actuarial package family**, at **version 2.7.0** (measured as `version = "2.7.0"` in `Project.toml`, with the registry identity `uuid = "b9b1ffdd-6612-4b69-8227-7663be06e089"`), **language Julia**, **licence MIT**, **measured 3 stars**, **998 KB**, **created 2022-06-14**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **default branch `main`**; **the README measures 1,457 bytes**. **The file listing was enumerated this round through a `codeload.github.com` tarball**, because the GitHub core API quota was exhausted, **and measures 30 paths: 7 directories and 23 files**, with `src/` holding `FinanceCore.jl`, `Contracts.jl`, `irr.jl`, `pv.jl` and `Rates.jl`; `test/` holding `runtests.jl`, `contracts.jl`, `irr.jl`, `present_value.jl`, `Rates.jl` and a `Project.toml`; `docs/` holding `make.jl`, a `Project.toml` and `src/index.md`; a single file under `ext/`; three workflows under `.github/workflows/`; and the root files `Project.toml`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `.gitignore` and `.git-blame-ignore-revs`. This entry belongs to this round theme, **wiring something up until another system can use it**; **this entry considers it the only one of the round four that discusses wiring at the level of dependency relationships, since it is itself the wire being plugged into**.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, `Project.toml`, the extension file, `CI.yml`, the blame-ignore file and the file listing**: **first, top: it states that you should generally not use it directly, and leaves exactly two exceptions** — verbatim, that the repository contains foundational types and routines used in other packages, followed by the statement that users should generally prefer to use other JuliaActuary packages which will re-export the FinanceCore data and methods as necessary, and then the exception, that if you are extending a function or type as a user or developer, then it would be a good idea to import or use this package directly. **The best documentation a low-level package can offer is not what it can do but which layer you should be using and when you should come down to this one**, and it pushes readers upstream rather than keeping users for itself. **Second, top: it lists who took what, in three sections** — the verbatim headings being that `irr` and `internal_rate_of_return` are re-exported by ActuaryUtilities.jl; that `Rate`s and `Frequency`s together with `discount`, `accumulation` and `forward` are re-exported by FinanceModels.jl; and that `Cashflow` and `Quote`, the `amount` and `timepoint` accessors, and `present_value` and `pv` are used by multiple packages. **So the listing answers who takes what from it and by which path, which is what a wiring diagram looks like at the package-management level: it does not describe itself, it describes its relationships upward.** **Third, top: it wires an optional dependency in as an acceleration backend through the Julia extension mechanism** — measured in `Project.toml`: `[weakdeps]` carries `LoopVectorization`, `[extensions]` maps `FinanceCoreLoopVectorizationExt` to `LoopVectorization`, and the corresponding file is measurably present under `ext/`. **Four things worth recording**: first, **the extension hooks in through a package-private function**, verbatim `FinanceCore._vectorization_backend(...)`, whose name carries a leading underscore, and it also redefines `FinanceCore.__pv_div_pv′`, whose name ends in a U+2032 prime character rather than an apostrophe; **this entry records honestly that this is a conventional rather than contractual attachment, since the extension point is not part of the public API but an in-package private name, and no judgement of its merits is offered here, though an underscore name carries no semantic stability promise and that is worth writing down**. Second, **it quantifies the numerical difference between the two backends**, verbatim: that reassociation and the LoopVectorization exponential may differ from the SIMD result by approximately one ulp, **which is far more useful than a promise of automatic acceleration, because the cost of going faster is written next to it**. Third, **the same file states a capability boundary**, verbatim: that the public IRR solver currently seeds Newton iteration with a Float64 so its Float32 cashflow path falls back to SIMD, and that Float32 remains valid for direct and future type-preserving solver calls, **one limitation plus one range that still holds**. Fourth, **it keeps a note about why the code looks like this**: the word currently in that sentence means the state of the implementation today rather than a design constraint. **Fourth, top: a CI job exists purely to run the lowest versions declared in the compat section** — the `downgrade` job uses `julia-actions/julia-downgrade-compat@v1` with `skip: Dates` and `strict: ‘true’`, and carries two verbatim comments: that it tests the lower bounds declared in the compat section by pinning dependencies to their oldest allowed versions before building, and that the exact equality-to-floor pins apply to every entry including those declared with a greater-or-equal bound, which the default version-zero behaviour would tilde-pin instead. **Lower bounds in a compat section are usually only a claim, and this repository wires the claim that the lower bound still works to a test that can fail, which makes the declared compatibility range checkable.** **This round the ASCII quotation marks of the original comments were rendered as curved quotation marks to keep this entry quote convention, with the comments themselves unchanged.** **Fifth: formatting and blame form a pair** — CI runs a `runic` job through `fredrikekre/runic-action@v1`, and the repository root carries a blame-ignore file whose contents are, verbatim, the comment about adding Runic formatting followed by three commit hashes: `288af3220d7e8e4506eda62d26091c97dec58102`, `0ce7dc006ac89a7184da17267fc17d530e5e3c7a` and `def34a8b2dcc09ffcd17ebcdd5a65c43bd034e2f`. **A formatting check and a blame ignore list are two halves of the same thing: adding a formatter pollutes the history, and this wires that pollution back out of blame.** **This round all three hashes were checked to be complete forty-character hexadecimal values.** **Sixth: the dependency surface is minimal** — `[deps]` measures exactly two entries, `Dates` and `Roots`, while `[compat]` additionally pins `Dates` to major version one, `Roots` to `1.0.12, 2`, `LoopVectorization` to `0.12.166` and Julia itself to `1.10`; **a package that many others depend on keeps two hard dependencies and puts acceleration behind a weak one, because the thinner the wiring layer the more packages can attach to it**. **Seventh: the test matrix spans three operating systems and four version labels** — ubuntu with the minimum supported version, ubuntu with version one, macOS, Windows and ubuntu with the pre-release version, **where the pre-release cell allows failure without turning the main status red** and fail-fast is disabled; coverage is produced into an lcov file and handed to Codecov with a token from secrets. **The minimum-supported cell and the pre-release cell each get their own slot with a different consequence for failure: one must pass and the other may not.** **Eighth: it also wires in two pieces of Julia ecosystem automation** — the three measured workflows are CI, CompatHelper, which opens pull requests when dependency compatibility bounds need raising, and TagBot, which tags releases after registration. **Ninth: five badges, all pointing at checkable objects** — stable and dev documentation, CI restricted to the main branch, Codecov, and an Aqua QA badge pointing at `JuliaTesting/Aqua.jl`. **Aqua is a tool in the Julia ecosystem for automated package quality consistency checks, but its checklist was not examined this round, so this entry does not describe what it checks.** **Tenth: the wiring to pooled entries** — this entry supplies the layer that `[[actuaryutilities-jl]]` and `[[financemodels-jl]]` both depend on, and adds a family dependency edge to `[[experienceanalysis-jl]]`, `[[mortalitytables-jl]]`, `[[lifecontingencies-jl]]`, `[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]`, `[[hmd-jl]]`, `[[copulas-jl]]` and `[[conformalprediction-jl]]`; against libraries such as `[[quantlib]]`, `[[financepy]]` and `[[yieldcurves]]`, which ship complete implementations, this entry records the opposite design choice of lifting shared types to the bottom and letting the upper layers re-export them.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[actuaryutilities-jl]] and [[financemodels-jl]]**, because **it is the smallest available sample of how an open actuarial family is layered**: types and shared arithmetic at the bottom, re-export upward, acceleration behind a weak dependency, and a CI job that actually installs the declared minimum versions.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, Julia was not installed, and the package was neither run nor tested** — nothing was instantiated, no test file was executed and no function was called — **so this entry does not claim that any function or type works as described, nor any performance or numerical conclusion**. **Second, no file under `src/` was read**: only the README, `Project.toml`, the extension file, `CI.yml`, the blame-ignore file and a complete file listing were read, **so this entry claims nothing about the signatures, return types, numerical behaviour, precision or convergence properties of `irr`, `pv`, `Rate`, `Cashflow` or any other API — this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the Aqua checklist, the current Codecov percentage and whether CompatHelper and TagBot are still running were not verified, and the documentation site was not opened.** **Fourth, the risk this entry points out is not a conclusion**: the extension attaches through a private function with a leading underscore, and whether that name survives later versions was not verified; **this entry records the fact only and makes no judgement about its stability**. **Fifth, the file listing came from a tarball rather than the GitHub tree endpoint**, since the core API quota was exhausted, **so the counts of 23 files and 7 directories are tarball figures**;
